event: 2026 ILCA 6 YOUTH EUROPEAN CHAMPIONSHIPS & OPEN EUROPEAN TROPHY
procedural_matters: ESP 222797 was represented by Juan Bennassar.
The race committee was represented by Athanasions Papantoniou (Principal Race Officer, Course Alfa).
Juan Jose Oliver (Coach ESP 222797) attended as an observer.
ESP 222797 filed a scoring inquiry at 19:39, on 15 July 2026.
Video from the pin end and audio recording from the starting vessel was presented to ESP 222797 during a scoring inquiry meeting.
The race committee responded to the scoring inquiry at 21:18, on 15 July 2026.
Hearing No. 6 was heard together with hearing No. 10 in accordance with RRS 63.2(b) since both hearings arose from the same incident
ESP 222797 presented tracking for race 4 ILCA 6 Men (blue fleet).
The panel of the international jury was composed in accordance with RRS N1.4(b).
facts: Uniform flag was displayed as the preparatory signal for race 4 of the ILCA 6 Men Blues fleet.
The race committee identified ESP 222797 as being in the triangle formed by the ends of the starting line and the first mark during the last minute before her starting signal.
ESP 222797 was scored UFD by the race committee in race 4.
ESP 222797 did not present any evidence to show that the race committee made an improper action or omission.
conclusions: There was neither an improper action nor improper omission of the race committee. Therefore, the requirements for redress in RRS 61.4(b)(1) are not met.
